# Signature input and output

Present technical content in a measured composition using the signature input and output layout.

Model: `signature-flow` · Family: Technical · Status: **in review**.

[Getting started](../../USING-STUDIO.md) · [All slide guides](../GUIDES.md) · [Current LaTeX source](../../../templates/studio/signature-flow.tex)

[Open this slide individually](../index.html?template=signature-flow)

![Signature input and output](../previews/signature-flow.png)

The preview shows the shipped defaults. The thin bottom label belongs to the review catalogue.

## Insert this slide

Place this command outside another `frame`:

```latex
\studiotemplate{signature-flow}
```

## Change the content

This example uses supported fields. Omitted fields keep their shipped defaults.

```latex
\studiotemplate[
  title={Digital signature},
  text-2={Private key}
]{signature-flow}
```

## Complete one-slide example

Create `my-slide.tex` in the project root and paste:

```latex
\documentclass[aspectratio=169]{beamer}
\usetheme{bitpolito-studio}
\usepackage{bitpolitostudiotemplates}
\usepackage[backend=biber]{biblatex}
\addbibresource{bibliography.bib}
\begin{document}
\studiotemplate[
  title={Digital signature},
  text-2={Private key}
]{signature-flow}
\end{document}
```

```sh
python3 scripts/build.py my-slide.tex
# Installed TeX alternative:
python3 scripts/build.py my-slide.tex --backend native
```

Output: `build/my-slide.pdf`. On Windows use `py -3` instead of `python3`.

## Editable fields

Positions and available space refer to the original, fixed composition.
In the individual web view, select a field or enable **Show editable areas** to locate it.

| Field | What it changes | Position | Available space | Shipped value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <code>graphic-1</code> | Replaceable graphic or decoration (graphic) | middle centre | 7.7% wide × 7.5% high | <code>\includegraphics[width=274\studiounit]{images/studio/collection/figma-0599-part-01.pdf}</code> |
| <code>graphic-2</code> | Replaceable graphic or decoration (graphic) | lower centre | 7.6% wide × 8.5% high | <code>\includegraphics[width=271\studiounit]{images/studio/collection/figma-0599-part-02.pdf}</code> |
| <code>graphic-3</code> | Replaceable graphic or decoration (graphic) | middle centre | 30.7% wide × 41.1% high | <code>\includegraphics[width=1093\studiounit]{images/studio/collection/figma-0599-part-03.pdf}</code> |
| <code>title</code> | Main text (text) | upper centre | 38.0% wide × 8.6% high | <code>Digital signature</code> |
| <code>text-2</code> | Editable text (text) | middle left | 17.3% wide × 6.4% high | <code>Private key</code> |
| <code>text-3</code> | Editable text (text) | lower left | 19.3% wide × 6.4% high | <code>Public key</code> |
| <code>text-4</code> | Editable text (text) | lower centre | 22.5% wide × 4.2% high | <code>Mathematical connection</code> |
| <code>text-5</code> | Editable text (text) | lower right | 10.6% wide × 5.6% high | <code>Signature</code> |

Truncated values are shown in full at the start of the current source file.
A text field accepts LaTeX; a graphic field accepts an icon, `\includegraphics`, TikZ or math.

## Replace a graphic

This example fits an icon inside the first graphic slot, preserving its proportions:

```latex
\studiotemplate[
  graphic-1={\asset[width=0.06935\paperwidth,height=0.06750\paperheight,keepaspectratio]{alice}}
]{signature-flow}
```

Use any graphic field listed above to target another slot. Some slots contain a complete
panel, background, screenshot or decoration. Inspect the preview before replacing them.

## Keep the composition

- Keep replacements within their allocated boxes. Shorten text or use explicit `\\` line breaks.
- Use `field={}` to hide content while retaining its space.
- Fonts, anchors and geometry remain fixed; unknown fields and overflowing content produce diagnostics.
- Text colour does not recolour supplied graphics; prepare another asset when its fixed colours must change.
- Some diagrams, QR codes and decorations are native source elements rather than configurable fields.
- For structural changes, edit [the current source](../../../templates/studio/signature-flow.tex). Catalogues and the showcase reuse it.
